newsitem.title: USA: Silver King stake cut by RMS group.
newsitem.headline: Silver King stake cut by RMS group.

text.p: A group including RMS Ltd, Crystal Diamond Inc and investor Roy Speer said Thursday it reduced its stake in Silver King Communications Inc to the equivalent of 10.2 percent, or 763,095 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said Speer sold 107,732 shares of Silver King between November 14 and 18 at prices ranging fromn $23.125 to $25 a share.
The group did not state any reason for the latest transaction in Silver King, a Los Angeles-based company that is the nation's sixth-largest television station concern.

The group's stake includes 347,114 common shares and 415,945 class B shares. Because the class B shares carry 10 votes each while the common shares have one vote each, the group is deemed to hold a 14.4 percent voting power of Silver King's outstanding capital stock, the filing said.
